mapper.insert: insert into ai_request_log (user_id, model_config_id, provider_type, model_name, request_type, business_type, business_id, request_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, duration_ms, success, error_code, error_message, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values (#{userId}, #{modelConfigId}, #{providerType}, #{modelName}, #{requestType}, #{businessType}, #{businessId}, #{requestId}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{durationMs}, #{success}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), '0')
mapper.sql: select l.id, l.user_id, l.model_config_id, c.name model_config_name, l.provider_type, l.model_name, l.request_type, l.business_type, l.business_id, l.request_id, l.prompt_tokens, l.completion_tokens, l.total_tokens, l.duration_ms, l.success, l.error_code, l.error_message, l.create_by, l.create_time from ai_request_log l left join ai_model_config c on c.id = l.model_config_id
